Occurrences.Kwic: 是魔業，至於佛語亦是魔業。是此意也。此直舉本分佛祖無功能，乾坤失色，日月無光。然法有多義，人有多機，不妨施設。法者，一物也；人者，眾生也。法有不變隨緣之義，人有頓悟漸修之機，故不妨文字語言之施設也。此所謂官不容針，私通車馬者也。眾生雖曰圓成，生無慧目，甘受輪轉，故若非出世之金鎞，誰刮無明之厚膜也？至於越苦海而登樂岸者，皆由大悲

Senses.Explanation: One member of explicit sudden-and-gradual fourfold sequences, translated without endorsing it as a prescribed sequence. One sequence lists sudden awakening with sudden refinement and sudden awakening with gradual refinement according to different capacities. Another contrasts sudden awakening and gradual refinement with sunrise followed by the gradual melting of frost and dew.
